free_tier.stated: All three model IDs (jad-ai, jad-go, jad-code) are free at USD 0 per million input tokens and USD 0 per million output tokens, with no billing step, no paid tier and no per-request charge.

record.tooling: an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint with a jad_ key and a JAD_API_KEY environment variable for OpenCode
record.chaining: the gateway routes only free-tier upstream models, so upstream availability is the scarce link

limits.value: USD 0 per million input and output tokens on all three model IDs
jad-go and jad-code output clamped to 16,384 tokens; jad-ai capped at 32,000 tokens

identity_cost.detail: create a key in Settings to API keys, shown once; no card or payment step is described

record.reliability_note: requests with images return 503 vision_unavailable if no vision-capable provider is configured; the gateway never executes tools itself and rejects unknown model IDs with 400
